title: POST /checkout_sessions/{id}/complete
context: Wires T4.1's Razorpay bridge into the checkout lifecycle, per PRD §5.2 and §5.5.
objective: Implement the complete endpoint: validate session is in an completable state, create the Razorpay order, transition session to completed, write an AuditEntry.
scope_in: Reject completion attempts on sessions not in created/updated status, with a clear error
On success: session.status = completed, session.payment_provider.razorpay_order_id populated, AuditEntry written with action=complete
Webhook stub: log a would-be webhook payload, don't need a real subscriber yet
scope_out: No cancel logic here — separate task
acceptance_criteria: Completing a valid created/updated session returns HTTP 200 with a populated razorpay_order_id
Completing an already-completed session returns a clear error, not a duplicate Razorpay order
AuditEntry document exists in Firestore for every successful completion, with correct before/after totals
Full sequence test: create -> update -> complete produces exactly one Razorpay order and one audit entry
